description: This source file implements the CoalescingCertVerifier class, which manages batching of certificate verification requests to optimize performance and resource usage. It defines classes for jobs and requests, handles verification logic, and manages request lifecycle and logging.

classes.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::Job
classes.description: Represents a verification job that batches multiple requests to a single underlying certificate verifier.

classes.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::Request
classes.description: Represents an individual certificate verification request attached to a Job, with callback handling and lifecycle management.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::Verify
methods.description: Main method to initiate a certificate verification request, either attaching to an existing job or creating a new one.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::SetConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration for the underlying verifier and resets job states accordingly.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to monitor verifier events.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::FindJob
methods.description: Finds an existing job matching the request parameters.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::RemoveJob
methods.description: Removes a specified job from tracking structures.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::IncrementGenerationAndMakeCurrentJobsUnjoinable
methods.description: Transitions current jobs to an in-flight state and makes new jobs unjoinable.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the underlying verifier, resetting current jobs.
